notes: archive: fig6f_hollow.json; digitized p/p0 0.0022; open-marker position = centroid of the marker interior (white pocket enclosed by the outline); very low pressure: 1 px = 0.0023 in p/p0, so the relative pressure uncertainty is large; pressure_bar = digitized p/p0 x 1 bar (p0 not printed; the paper states the H2 isotherms were collected up to 1 bar and Table 3 gives the p/p0 = 1 values as 1 bar); isotherm_point_count approximate: 19 open (DES) markers counted in Fig. 6; adsorption markers counted as 20 at p/p0 >= 0.03 (Fig. 5/6) plus about 5 overlapping markers in the low-pressure cluster that cannot all be resolved; Micromeritics ASAP 2460 (volumetric); H2 pretreatment: vacuum P <= 1e-5 mbar (stored as 0.001 Pa) at 473 K (stored 199.85 C); duration not stated for H2 (12 h stated for the N2 porosimetry degassing); wt% convention W1 from 'expressed in wt% (weight percent of adsorbed gas per gram of adsorbent)' (p. 1031); Vsuper (0.7-2 nm) 0.352 cm3/g, %micro 70 (Table 2); Vultra (d<0.7 nm), Vmicro (d<2 nm) and Vmeso (2-50 nm) by NLDFT (slit pores) from N2 at 77 K; VT from N2 uptake at p/p0 0.995 (Table 2); BET range: p/p0 0.01-0.30 (BET correlation coefficient >0.9998; no consistency criteria stated); EDX (Table S6) wt%: C 84.3, O 10.4, Mg 1.1, Al 0.9, Si 2.0, K 0.8, Ca 0.5 (at%: C 89.4, O 8.3, Mg 0.6, Al 0.4, Si 0.9, K 0.3, Ca 0.2); yield 1.08% (Table 1); precursor: spent coffee grounds (Coffea arabica, local coffee shop) dried at 378 K for 2 h, ground and sieved (<=0.5 mm); reconciled (C): kept from extractor B row HYC-0106-M286 (no matching A row)
